description: This file defines utility functions for the Windows runner component of a Flutter application. It declares functions for creating consoles, converting UTF-16 strings to UTF-8, and retrieving command-line arguments.

methods.name: CreateAndAttachConsole
methods.description: Creates a console window for the process and redirects stdout and stderr to it for both the runner and Flutter libraries.

methods.name: Utf8FromUtf16
methods.description: Converts a null-terminated UTF-16 encoded wchar_t* string to a UTF-8 encoded std::string. Returns an empty string upon failure.

methods.name: GetCommandLineArguments
methods.description: Retrieves command line arguments passed to the process as a vector of UTF-8 encoded strings. Returns an empty vector on failure.
